member.name: P:BeeAppie.Unity.UI.BeeAppieUI.CelebrateAchievements
member.summary: Shows "Achievement unlocked" at the top of the screen for a few seconds when one is unlocked on this device (Unlocked). On by default; turn it off to celebrate in your own way.

member.name: P:BeeAppie.Unity.UI.BeeAppieUI.Appearance
member.summary: Light (the default) or dark promos, e.g. to match the game's own theme.

member.name: M:BeeAppie.Unity.UI.BeeAppieUI.ShowFullscreenPromoAsync
member.summary: Shows a fullscreen promo of one of your other apps over the game, e.g. between levels or where an interstitial ad failed to load. The player can close it at once (the close button, or Back on Android). Completes once it has closed: true if one was shown, false (at once) when there was nothing to show or it was too soon (at most one every few minutes, as set in the dashboard, and never on the game's first launch). Never throws. await BeeAppieUI.ShowFullscreenPromoAsync();

member.name: M:BeeAppie.Unity.UI.BeeAppieUI.ShowSurveyAsync(System.String,BeeAppie.Unity.SurveyPosition)
member.summary: Asks the feature survey (set up under Surveys in the dashboard) as a card over the game, dimmed behind it, at . Completes once it has closed: Answered, Dismissed, or NotShown at once when there was nothing to ask (not live, not for this platform or version, answered already, asked lately, offline, a plan without surveys, or another survey on screen). Never throws. await BeeAppieUI.ShowSurveyAsync("level-value", SurveyPosition.Bottom);

member.name: T:BeeAppie.Unity.UI.BeeAppieAppearance
member.summary: Light or dark promo colours (Unity cannot read the system's setting on every platform).

member.name: T:BeeAppie.Unity.UI.PromoView
member.summary: A slot showing promos of your other apps (, ): add it to an object under a Canvas. It loads, rotates and reports on its own: a view counts when at least half of it is on screen for a second with the game in the foreground, at least the slot's minimum size (a banner 200 × 40 points, a card 120 × 100) and not faded out by a CanvasGroup, and a tap opens the app's store listing. When there is nothing to show (no other app to promote, promos turned off, a game made for kids, offline before the first promos) it takes no space and raises ; never an error. Its size is in points, so it looks the same whatever the Canvas Scaler.

member.name: P:BeeAppie.Unity.UI.PromoView.Promo
member.summary: The promo on screen; null while there is none.

member.name: E:BeeAppie.Unity.UI.PromoView.NoPromo
member.summary: Raised when there is nothing to show: the view has collapsed to no size. Once until a promo shows again; the view keeps asking now and then on its own.

member.name: M:BeeAppie.Unity.UI.PromoView.Reload

member.name: T:BeeAppie.Unity.UI.PromoBannerView
member.summary: A promo banner: the full width of its parent, 50 to 90 points high depending on the width (about 56 on a phone, 90 on a tablet). Put it at the bottom of a screen, or where an ad banner failed to load: e.g. on an object anchored to the bottom of the Canvas and stretched across it.

member.name: T:BeeAppie.Unity.UI.PromoCardView
